<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$forge-skill-from-conversations</code></p>

Turn recurring work from supplied or recent Codex conversations into one focused, evaluated skill candidate. Use only when explicitly invoked with $forge-skill-from-conversations; require approval before creation or adoption.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link forge-skill-from-conversations --scope user
arcantry skills link forge-skill-from-conversations --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link forge-skill-from-conversations --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Create a skill from recent work

**Prompt**

> Use $forge-skill-from-conversations on these selected completed tasks and propose one reusable skill candidate.

**Expected outcome**

One evidence-backed candidate, a stop for approval, an isolated implementation, and held-out evaluation before adoption.

### Use supplied conversation evidence

**Prompt**

> Use $forge-skill-from-conversations on this transcript. Do not scan other tasks or install anything without asking.

**Expected outcome**

A privacy-scoped skill-forging flow that preserves separate approval for the candidate and its installation.
